Some of the most meaningful ideas begin with a simple wish: to make everyday life a little easier for someone you love. Meet Adaptalyfe, founded by Rachel Barrett, a mother who wanted her son to experience greater independence, confidence and freedom in his everyday life. When reminders, responsibilities and multi-step routines became overwhelming, Rachel saw the need for a different kind of support — one that helps people build independence without feeling constantly managed. That personal journey inspired AdaptTheApp and the creation of Adaptalyfe. At the heart of Adaptalyfe is a powerful belief: needing support and being independent can go hand in hand. By helping make everyday routines and responsibilities easier to navigate, Adaptalyfe aims to support individuals in building confidence and taking greater ownership of their lives. Because real support isn't about doing everything for someone. It's about helping them discover what they can do for themselves. Meet Berly — a trauma-informed coach helping women understand themselves, their patterns, and the emotional connections that can be difficult to break. 💜 Her work comes from a place of deep understanding and compassion. She creates space for women to look beneath the surface — to understand why they may keep returning to relationships or patterns that hurt them, why leaving can feel so difficult, and what may be happening emotionally beneath it all. Rather than simply telling women to “move on,” her approach focuses on awareness, understanding and healing — helping women recognize trauma bonds, understand their experiences, and begin building a stronger relationship with themselves. She also offers a FREE Breaking Trauma Bonds Webinar, giving women an opportunity to learn more about these patterns and gain a deeper understanding of what they may be experiencing.
